name: Hemlock Grove
description: One cannot quench his all-consuming thirst. The other cannot tame the beast clawing its way out. In the sleepy Pennsylvania village of Hemlock Grove, two young men struggle to accept painful truths: about family, themselves, the mystery of the White Tower - and a terrifying new threat so powerful it will turn them from predators into prey.

videos.title: Jellyfish in the Sky
videos.overview: A teenager is murdered in the woods of Hemlock Grove. Evidence points to an animal attack but suspicions soon fall on Peter, the newly arrived gypsy.

videos.title: The Angel
videos.overview: Roman confronts Peter at the crime scene, finding common ground. Letha reveals a shocking secret and Olivia and Norman fall into old habits.

videos.title: The Order of the Dragon
videos.overview: Christina discovers a new victim and Sheriff Sworn gets outside help from Dr. Chasseur. Now a suspect, Peter joins Roman to find the killer.

videos.title: In Poor Taste
videos.overview: Letha's interest in Peter takes a turn. Chasseur and Sworn's investigation hits a new low while Roman and Peter stay one step ahead.

videos.title: Hello, Handsome
videos.overview: Shelley's connection to Dr. Pryce is further revealed, Destiny helps Peter understand the recent murder and the gala at the Tower goes horribly awry.

videos.title: The Crucible
videos.overview: Peter and Roman follow Lisa Willoughby's trail to the old steel mill where they find a missing piece of the puzzle. Christina's date goes poorly.

videos.title: Measure of Disorder
videos.overview: Shelley commits an act of independence, Chasseur questions Roman but crosses paths with Olivia, and Peter and Roman's friendship takes a turn.

videos.title: Catabasis
videos.overview: After drunkenly attacking the Godfrey Institute, Roman falls into a coma and embarks on a subconscious journey of shocking truths and revelations.

videos.title: What Peter Can Live Without
videos.overview: As a full moon approaches, Letha's parents discover her relationship with Peter. Despite a crisis of faith, Chasseur prepares to capture the killer.

videos.title: What God Wants
videos.overview: A weakened Roman emerges from his coma and reunites with Peter to stop the killer. Hemlock Grove braces itself for another lethal full moon.

videos.title: The Price
videos.overview: Peter and his mother hide from vigilantes seeking the killer, while Christina disappears, and Roman finally begins to face the truth about his nature.

videos.title: Children of the Night
videos.overview: As Olivia and Chasseur face off at the Mill, Shelley learns the awful truth about her family, and Peter and Roman uncover the killer's identity.

videos.title: Birth
videos.overview: The tragic conclusion to the Hemlock Grove killing spree leaves both the Godfrey and Rumancek families devastated, with the final horror yet to come.

videos.title: Blood Pressure
videos.overview: Peter returns to Hemlock Grove in search of money to afford a lawyer for Lynda while Roman tries to satiate his newly found appetite.

videos.title: Gone Sis
videos.overview: Roman invites an outsider to be his guest. Destiny attempts to bring clarity to Peter’s dreams. Olivia grows frustrated adapting to her ailments.

videos.title: Luna Rea
videos.overview: Peter explores the scene of his haunted premonitions. Meanwhile, Olivia demands exclusivity from Norman at all costs.

videos.title: Bodily Fluids
videos.overview: Roman’s hunger tempts him beyond his self-control. New evidence arises in the search for Shelley. Peter comes to the aid of a child in need.

videos.title: Hemlock Diego's Policy Player's Dream Book
videos.overview: Miranda and Roman seek medical advice. Peter and Destiny must find a new way of helping Lynda when her attorney informs them the case is hopeless.

videos.title: Such Dire Stuff
videos.overview: Roman undertakes his first treatment with Dr. Pryce; Norman sets up a rendezvous with a beloved relative he thought was lost forever.

videos.title: Lost Generation
videos.overview: A family reunion unfolds with layers of typical Godfrey dysfunction. Peter and Roman’s quest to save lives forces them to reveal their true natures.

videos.title: Unicorn
videos.overview: Roman tells Norman the truth about their family. Olivia’s rehabilitation takes an unexpected turn. Destiny discovers what the murderers are plotting.

videos.title: Tintypes
videos.overview: While Peter undergoes questioning, Roman proceeds with his final transfusion. An unexpected alliance forms when a threat to Olivia’s life is revealed.

videos.title: Demons and the Dogstar
videos.overview: Peter recuperates at home. At the White Tower, Roman takes care of unfinished business and Norman has a final confrontation with Olivia.

videos.title: A Place to Fall
videos.overview: The search for Miranda and Nadia digs into Spivak's past. Roman has an encounter with a mysterious stranger. Andreas and Destiny plan their future.

videos.title: Souls on Ice
videos.overview: Annie reveals her secrets to Roman as they probe a connection between two attacks. Olivia is unable to feed and Miranda must fend for herself.

videos.title: The House in the Woods
videos.overview: Pryce deduces the nature of the creature and looks for links to the Pivak monster. Roman explores upir customs. Peter grills Andreas about the heist.

videos.title: Every Beast
videos.overview: Peter Makes a bold move to head off a war between the Gypsies and the Croatian mob. After an agonizing detox, Pryce delivers disturbing news.

videos.title: Boy in the Box
videos.overview: Ochoa encourages Olivia to reach out to Annie. Destiny's sanity begins to crumble in Andreas's absence, and Pryce is besieged by childhood memories.

videos.title: Pendant
videos.overview: As Olivia's condition worsens, she drops a bombshell on Roman. The wolf pack struggles to hide the truth about Andreas from Destiny.

videos.title: Todos Santos
videos.overview: A plan to save Olivia requires a search for the perfect mark at an upir conference. Destiny confronts Roman about Andreas.

videos.title: Dire Night on the Worm Moon
videos.overview: Aitor ponders leaving Hemlock Grove and asks Shelley to join him. Roman manipulates Peter into turning on Milan.

videos.title: Damascus
videos.overview: Gruesome discoveries await Roman and Peter at Spivak's cabin. As Olivia's time runs out, she targets her son. Pryce consoles a heartbroken Shelley.

videos.title: Brian's Song
videos.overview: Blinsky tends to Roman's wounds at the White Tower. After leaving Nadia with Shelley, Annie confronts Olivia about her father's death.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 5 nominations total
